tour.overview:
Moorea, a short ferry ride from Tahiti, is a heart-shaped island of jagged green peaks cut by two deep bays, Cook's Bay and Opunohu Bay. Its lagoon is shallow and clear, home to stingrays, reef sharks, turtles and coral gardens, and from July to October humpback whales come to its waters to give birth.

This private boat day shows the lagoon with a local guide, at your pace and without other groups on board.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 6 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Moorea or the ferry terminal
• Type: private boat with captain and local guide
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Cook’s Bay and Opunohu Bay.
• The stingray sandbank.
• The coral gardens.
• A motu.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private boat lets you choose quiet moments at each site, and your guide knows the best spots for turtles.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples, honeymooners and day visitors from Tahiti.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the island interior, choose our Moorea island tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The ferry from Papeete takes about 30 to 45 minutes; we can arrange tickets and meet you at the terminal.

days.name: The bays, the stingray sandbank, the coral gardens and a picnic on a motu
days.description:
What to expect: a day on Moorea’s lagoon with snorkelling and a picnic.

Your boat collects you at about 9:00. You cruise into Opunohu Bay and Cook's Bay, deep fjord-like bays surrounded by peaks such as Mount Rotui and Mouaroa, while your guide tells the story of Captain Cook and the island's legends. Outside the reef, dolphins are often seen, and from July to October humpback whales.

On the sandbank in the lagoon, you stand in clear, shallow water as stingrays glide around you and blacktip reef sharks pass by. At the coral gardens, you snorkel among reef fish, and at a site where tiki statues stand on the sea floor. Your guide looks for sea turtles.

At midday you land on a motu for a picnic of poisson cru, grilled fish, rice, breadfruit and fruit, with a demonstration of coconut opening, and time to swim before you return.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Pick-up.
09:30 – Opunohu Bay and Cook’s Bay.
10:30 – Stingray sandbank.
11:30 – Coral gardens and tikis.
12:30 – Picnic on a motu.
14:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Whale watching (July to October) follows strict rules to protect the whales.
• Reef-safe sun cream only.

INCLUDED: private boat and captain, local guide, snorkelling equipment, picnic, fruit and drinks, bottled water, pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: ferry tickets from Tahiti, alcoholic drinks, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Can we do this as a day trip from Tahiti?
faq.answer: Yes. Take the early ferry; we meet you at the terminal.

faq.question: Are the ferry tickets included?
faq.answer: Not by default; we can add them.

faq.question: Will we see whales?
faq.answer: Humpback whales are often seen from July to October. They are wild, so sightings are never guaranteed.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, a picnic on a motu.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child life vests are provided.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. Boarding the boat needs a step.

faq.question: Do we need to be good swimmers?
faq.answer: Basic swimming ability is enough; the sandbank is shallow.

faq.question: What should we bring?
faq.answer: Swimwear, a towel, a hat, sunglasses and reef-safe sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year. July to October for whales.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not customary in French Polynesia and is never expected, but a small gesture for excellent service is always appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
